The necklace features a twisted wire chain (appearing copper or bronze) and a large, circular pendant. The pendant has a pale green, possibly enameled or polymer clay base with a raised, embroidered or sculpted design of two pink/magenta butterfly wings facing each other. A small silver bead connects the pendant to the chain.
